name: Nuvio iOS (Unofficial AltStore Source)
subtitle: Unofficial AltStore repository for official full Nuvio iOS builds.
description: Unofficial AltStore-compatible repository for official Nuvio iOS builds. Links will be updated regularly each official GitHub releases. You can install Nuvio on eligible app updater (AltStore/Feather/KSign/ESign), etc.

apps.localizedDescription: Nuvio — A free, open-source media app for your phone, your desktop, and the TV you already own. Bring your own sources. Nuvio turns them into a library with artwork, ratings, subtitles, and your place saved on every screen.
